Original game: Mahō no Tō by NAO (PC-98, 1996)
Original English text checked by Tween and Miki Olsz
Since then, the tower has inspired thousands
of fan-made towers around the world.
NAO kindly allows fan works based on the game.

Now is the time to act.
With the power of omniscience
I shall break the sacred sword
and receive great wisdom.

The long war has come to an end,
and the tower of vanity has fallen.

The gods have returned to the heavens,
the soldiers to the earth.

The present has turned into the past,
and this journey into a memory.

You will look back for a moment,
then take a step toward a new journey.
